content: Formatting / presentation * Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement . Use << >> rather than and tags for bold syntax. * Please remove the headings (Goal, Input, etc.) from the individual sections. * Since this is a Reverse-mode-only clash, please add the following at the beginning of the Goal section: <> Cases * Since this is a Reverse-mode-only clash, please reorder and revise the cases so that it's possible for players to infer the task from the visible tests alone. * Please also ensure that each test and its corresponding validator cover the *same scenario* wile using *slightly different inputs and outputs*. Thanks.
